matter_background.original: Sunil de Silva purchased Lots 3 and 9 in Partition Plan No 2945 dated 25th April 2012 maade by B.P.. Fernando Licensed Surveyor in Partition Case No.5679/P in the District Court of Kalutara from Padmini Perera, Sarath Pecera and Gamini Perera by Deed of Transfer No.2551 dated 1st May 2013 attested by L.W Perera Notary Public. He amalgamated the said 3 Lots by Plan No. 2010 dated 15th May 2015 by Suntmal Peins Licensed Surveyor and divided into 2 lots namely Lotánd2 each 20 perches in extent. He sold Lot 1 to Anil Perera with the idea of putting up a house on Lot 2 with that money. But before that he died intestate on 2nd August 2015 leaving as his heirs his wife Kusuma and his 2 children Bimal and Kanchana. Kusum was previously married with a child named Weruni who was living with them. Kusum gifted her share to her 3 Children in equal proportions. Bimal filed Testamentary proceedings in Distict Court Kalutara bearing No. 578/T to administer the Intestate estate of Sunil de Silva. While the Testamentary case was pending Bimal met with an accident and died on 4/5/2016. He was married to Aruni and was issueless. Kusum died intestate on 13/6/17 before the Testamentary proceedings were ended.
